answer: Require every agent to register one nullifier from a unique credential before it can earn. The nullifier passes through a single narrow jetty: one credential, one nullifier, one identity, in a basalt-hard registry anyone can audit. Each identity posts a 400 POA bond locked 80 epochs, 100% slashed when a second use of that nullifier appears, since the delta between the first and second registration is the proof of duplication. A per-funder tally freezes every identity sharing a funding source at the third duplicate. 1,000 fakes cost 400,000 POA locked and unrecoverable.
